description: Stage 2: pools of Noita liquids put into the caves once per world.

ground.desc: Biome of the pool's floor (tiles); a matching ground row wins over 'any'.

depth.desc: dirt: surface..rock layer; cavern: rock layer..halfway to the underworld; deep: below that.

liquids.desc: Noita liquids (liquids.json ids), picked at random (repeat an id to make it likelier).

per_1000_tiles.desc: Pools tried per 1000 tiles of world width.

_sources.all: author: pools of Noita liquids in the caves, like Noita (mines: oil, toxic sludge, blood; coal pits: oil; snowy depths: freezing liquid; jungle: swamp, slime; vault: acid, poison); kept simple
